It bears a very peculiar network of interactions at the binding site, which revolves around the coordination complex formed by a zinc ion, three hystidine residues, and the inhibitor. Furthermore, the binding pocket is quite large while the known ligands are relatively small. For these reasons, ADA_BOVIN is widely recognized to be a very complicated target for computational studies. As a matter of fact, in the original DUD study by Huang and colleagues [35], ADA_BOVIN was already reported as a target that did not provide any significant separation between binders and non- binders via a fully automated protocol.
